爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD007 横谷悠希子Yokotani Yukiko-冰淇淋上的心跳
她捧着融化的冰淇淋，指尖沾了甜腻的奶油，正要舔去时，他突然凑近。
热气喷在她耳边：“让我尝尝？”她脸瞬间红透，心跳快得像要跳出胸口，冰淇淋滑落，他却轻轻含住她的指尖。
她羞得闭上眼，却主动把剩下的递到他唇边，两人的舌尖在甜蜜中缠绕，心跳声重叠成最完美的共鸣。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD007 Yokotani Yukiko-Heart-Heartbeat on Ice Cream
She held the melting ice cream, her fingertips stained with sweet cream, and was about to lick it when he suddenly leaned in.
His breath warm against her ear: "Let me try some?" Her face instantly flushed red, her heart pounding as if it would burst from her chest. The ice cream slipped, but he gently took her fingertip into his mouth.
She closed her eyes shyly, but offered the rest to his lips. Their tongues intertwined in sweetness, their heartbeats overlapping in a perfect harmony.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
